English: Burning Within
Increases the Per-Turn Damage of this debuff by 5 points.
Chinese: 每次触发时，使这个减益的每回合伤害量提升5点。

English: Heat Death

At the start of each turn, restore HP equal to the highest single-instance damage you took in the previous turn.
Highest damage taken this turn: <color=#FFA500>&a</color>
Highest damage taken last turn: <color=#FFA500>&b</color>
Chinese:
每个回合开始时，恢复「上个回合中，自己受到过的最高的单次伤害值」的体力。
当前回合受到过的最高伤害：<color=#FFA500>&a</color>
上个回合受到过的最高伤害：<color=#FFA500>&b</color>

English: Healing Gauge Protection

When taking Pain Damage, increase MAXHP by same value.
For every 6 HP lost, gain '+1% Attack Power'.
Chinese:
受到痛苦伤害时，提升等量的最大体力值。
每失去6体力值，自身获得“+1%攻击力”。

English: The Rain Formerly Known as Purple
When taking damage, increase Attack Power by same value until the end of the turn.
Chinese: 受到伤害时，直到回合结束前，攻击力增加那个数值的值。

English: Cutting Mercy

Among countless shattered fragments of worlds, she chose to become the 'Feiyap' who is a Star Killer.
Wielding dominion over the 'Death' of all things in the astral realm, she drifts between the stars, mercilessly devouring planets fated to perish.
Where her Katana cuts, fractured space collapses into black holes, tearing apart everything before her. Her ruthlessness and cruelty have earned her the fearful title Silent Starfall among living worlds.
'Not even light can escape my grasp—let alone you.'
Chinese:
于万千碎裂的世界破片中，选择成为了斩星官的那一个“绯夜氏”。
掌管着星界万事万物的“死亡”，流浪在星际之间，毫不留情地吞噬着那些命定逝去的星球。
其太刀划过的地方，破碎的空间化作黑洞，撕碎面前的一切事物。她的无情与残忍，被那些有生命的星球们恐惧地冠以「无声星陨」的称号。
「就连光也无法逃脱我的掌控，更何况是你呢？」

English: Star Killer
Feiyap
Restores an ally's HP to 100% and revives them if they are incapacitated.
Chinese: 恢复友军100%的体力值，同时解除无法战斗状态。

English: Burn Full Duck

On a plain so vast its end cannot be seen, stand the corpses of countless swords and the tombstones of the blacksmiths who forged them.
At the center of this nameless Sword Graveyard, a lone girl stands.
Behind her, fragments of shattered planets hover like a silent crown, foretelling the fate of all who stand before her.
'Victory... or annihilation.'—thus declares the girl.
Chinese:
在漫长到看不见尽头的平原之上，立着无数「剑」的尸体，以及铸造它们的铁匠的墓碑。
无名的剑冢中央，伫立着一名少女。
在她背后，破碎的星球残片化作沉默的王冕高悬于空，昭示着你们所有人的结局。
「胜利，否则毁灭。」——少女如此宣告道。
